# Fervenza

> Fervenza is a luxury destination wedding planner in France and a pioneer of the all-inclusive celebration: a single integrated team designs, produces and delivers the entire weekend, from venue and Michelin dining to scenography, music, guest logistics and formalities, under one contact and one budget.

Born from a decade producing the world's most demanding events, Fervenza reinvented the wedding model: not a planner who coordinates outside vendors, but one house that conceives and runs the whole celebration. We work across Paris, Provence, the French Riviera, the Loire Valley, Bordeaux, the Landes and the French Alps, in chateaux, private museums, vineyards and seafront villas, with Michelin chefs and one multilingual contact who replies personally within 24 hours. Each celebration is built from scratch around the couple; the collections below are signature starting points we shape entirely to you. Celebrations range from intimate elopements for two to weddings of 350 guests, over two to four days; indicative budgets run from €44,000 to more than €2.2 million, and every quote is bespoke.

## The Experience
- [Home](https://www.fervenza.fr/): Luxury destination wedding planner for international couples across France: Paris, Provence, the French Riviera, the Loire Valley, Bordeaux, the Landes and the Alps. Chateaux, private museums, Michelin chefs.
- [Fervenza, luxury destination wedding planner](https://www.fervenza.fr/fervenza-luxury-destination-wedding-planner): The story and team behind Fervenza: a production heritage from the world's most demanding events, now devoted to intimate luxury celebrations across France.
- [The Fervenza Experience](https://www.fervenza.fr/the-fervenza-experience): The all-inclusive Fervenza experience: bespoke celebrations, destination expertise and one dedicated team crafting extraordinary moments across France.
- [Full wedding service](https://www.fervenza.fr/the-fervenza-experience/full-wedding-service): Pioneers of the all-inclusive celebration. One team, one budget, no surprises: Fervenza designs, coordinates and orchestrates your entire weekend, from venue to last dance.
- [Peace of mind](https://www.fervenza.fr/the-fervenza-experience/peace-of-mind): A dedicated cover placed with the insurer Lloyd's, staged payments and settlement in euros or US dollars: plan your celebration with complete peace of mind.
- [Occasions](https://www.fervenza.fr/occasions): From proposals to engagement parties and wedding anniversaries: every celebration deserves to be extraordinary.

## Destinations
- [All destinations](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations): Fervenza's wedding destinations in France, organised by region, atmosphere and occasion.
- [France](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france): Fervenza's wedding regions across France: Paris, Provence, the French Riviera, the Loire Valley and the Landes.
- [Paris](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/paris): The first thing you feel in Paris is the golden light filling its ancient courtyards, and the sense that every hidden corner holds a love story. Fervenza gives your celebration its complete attention and access to a private Paris of hidden museums, palaces and secret gardens.
- [Provence](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/provence): What Provence holds in its olive groves no season has erased: centuries of patience, the song of the cicadas, the scent of wild herbs. Celebrations in mas, bastides and vineyards between the Alpilles, the Luberon and the Camargue, with Michelin tables.
- [French Riviera](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/french-riviera): Those who know the French Riviera do not come for the Promenade des Anglais, but for the private villas of the Cap and the addresses passed quietly from hand to hand. Palaces, seafront villas and yachts along the Mediterranean.
- [Loire Valley](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/loire-valley): Long before these châteaux became monuments to visit, they held the court's most intimate moments: people married here, where the fate of nations was decided. Royal châteaux and formal gardens for multi-day celebrations.
- [Landes](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/landes): Some places are bound to slowness by their geography: between a saltwater lake, the ocean and the largest pine forest in Europe, the Landes are one of them. 1930s villas and wellness micro weddings with a ceremony in the sand.

## Signature Collections
- [Sun-Kissed Provence Wedding](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/provence/luxury-wedding-provence): Gather your people in a Provençal mas, say the words in a courtyard three centuries old, and let the cicadas carry the rest. Fervenza builds this wedding with you across three days between Saint-Rémy and the Alpilles, from the welcome dinner under the plane trees to the ceremony in the courtyard, the guinguette until dawn, and the closing lunch at Baumanière. Provence, wedding, 3 days, 80 to 160 guests, starting budget €140,000.
- [Vineyard Romance in the Luberon](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/provence/luberon-vineyard-wedding): To marry amid the vines of the Luberon: the garrigue, fresh thyme, golden stone, the cicadas. Fervenza builds this celebration with you across three days where your guests inhabit Provence, dance with their feet in the grass, and leave with your wedding cuvée, uncorked for the first time on the evening of your Yes. Provence, wedding, 3 days, 80 to 180 guests, starting budget €140,000.
- [Art Celebration at Château La Coste](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/provence/wedding-chateau-la-coste): At Château La Coste, the greatest living artists create works for this precise terrain. Fervenza composes your wedding here, one of four per season: three days that begin among the vines, a dusk walk with the curator through thirty works by Tadao Ando, Louise Bourgeois and Frank Gehry, a ceremony at the foot of the chosen artwork, a triply starred dinner by Florent Pietravalle and a private concert by the artist you love. Provence, wedding, 3 days, 120 to 250 guests, starting budget €2,200,000.
- [Untamed Camargue Wedding](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/provence/wild-wedding-camargue): A territory reserved for the initiated: Fervenza opens the gates to the wild Camargue, a natural jewel twenty minutes from Arles. Two days of celebration in total escape, marked by white horses and the pink of flamingos, a wedding suspended in time for lovers of nature and flamenco. Camargue, Provence, wedding, 2 days, 20 to 80 guests, starting budget €180,000.
- [A Wedding Reinvented as a Private Festival](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/provence/festival-wedding-provence): Claim a grand Provençal estate and turn your wedding into a private festival: the ceremony holds the centre of the day, then the celebration spills across the grounds. Fervenza stages open-air chef stations, free circulation and a live concert by the couple's own favourite band. Two days where the wedding is the reason for the festival, not the other way around. Provence, wedding, 2 days, 100 to 180 guests, starting budget €250,000.
- [A Royal Wedding in Secret Gourmet Paris](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/paris/paris-wedding-museum): Rediscover the Paris that kings once knew, when the Louvre was a palace and its galleries hosted the kingdom's greatest celebrations. Fervenza builds this celebration with you over three days in Royal Paris: the Sainte-Chapelle for vows at dusk, the Louvre privatised the moment the public leaves, a symphony orchestra, and a signature dessert by a renowned pastry chef. Paris, wedding, 3 days, 120 to 350 guests, starting budget €1,900,000.
- [A Florentine Wedding in the Heart of Paris](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/paris/florentine-wedding): A step from the Tuileries, on Rue Cambon, the Hôtel Castille is a five-star house with a Florentine soul: a private patio, a stone fountain, the Italian table of Ugo Alciati. Fervenza composes your wedding here, for twelve to thirty of your closest, sheltered from view. Paris, micro-wedding, 3 days, 12 to 30 guests, starting budget €44,000.
- [Legendary Wedding at the Mythic Riviera Palace](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/french-riviera/wedding-french-riviera): Claim the iconic Riviera palace that seduced Picasso and Grace Kelly. Fervenza composes three days of grand Mediterranean luxury at Cap-Eden-Roc: a candlelit cocktail, a ceremony facing the thousand blues of the sea, dinner under the pines, an Italian-style grand brunch, and a privatised beach club offered by the couple to their guests. French Riviera, wedding, 3 days, 80 to 250 guests, starting budget €1,800,000.
- [A Festive Union on the Côte d'Azur](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/french-riviera/glamorous-villa-celebration): To say Yes facing the sea, claiming the glamour and discretion of the Côte d'Azur. Fervenza builds this celebration with you: three festive days with the air of dolce vita, the Mediterranean as backdrop, building to the fireworks, in a villa rented in full where the celebration never stops. French Riviera, micro-wedding, 3 days, 60 to 140 guests, starting budget €220,000.
- [Wellness Micro Wedding in Hossegor](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/landes/wellness-micro-wedding-hossegor): Marry with your feet in the sand, steps from the Atlantic, with your closest gathered for four days in a 1930s villa on Hossegor's saltwater lake. Around the beach ceremony, Fervenza composes wide days: sunrise yoga facing the lake, an alcohol-free bar, a starred chef cooking the Landes terroir, surf and paddle, oysters at the cabanas at sunset, and a final fire on the sand. Landes, micro-wedding, 4 days, 8 to 14 guests, starting budget €110,000.
- [Micro Winter Mountain Wedding](https://www.fervenza.fr/luxury-wedding-destinations/france/alpes/elopement-megeve-alps): Above Megève, a plateau faces Mont Blanc. A horse-drawn sleigh carries the couple up through the forest; they exchange vows in the snow to a string trio, then a starred chef signs dinner at a venue privatised for the night. Fervenza composes every detail of this winter elopement, from two to fifteen guests. French Alps, elopement, 2 days, 2 to 15 guests, starting budget €85,000.
